Class LossIfBroke

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.instant.CardEffectInstant
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.instant.LossIfBroke
public class LossIfBroke extends CardEffectInstant
An instant effect that penalises a player who cannot pay a food cost.

When applied, the rule defined by lossIfBrokeType deducts foodCost food from the player if they have enough, or ppCost prestige points instead if they do not.
